// matcherSetHasExpressionMatcher reports whether a matcher set contains
// an expression matcher that references response placeholders (such as
// {http.reverse_proxy.status_code} or {rp.status_code}). Expressions that
// only test request properties are not response conditions, so matcher
// sets containing only those are not evaluated for response-based retry
// decisions.
func matcherSetHasExpressionMatcher(matcherSet caddyhttp.MatcherSet) bool {
	for _, m := range matcherSet {
		if me, ok := m.(*caddyhttp.MatchExpression); ok && expressionReferencesResponse(me.Expr) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// expressionReferencesResponse reports whether a CEL expression refers to
// reverse proxy response placeholders.
func expressionReferencesResponse(expr string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(expr, "{http.reverse_proxy.") || strings.Contains(expr, "{rp.")
}
